findings.key_quote: R&D expense increased $1.87 billion, or 41%, in the year ended December 31, 2025 as compared to the year ended December 31, 2024, primarily due to increases in costs related to AI and other programs
findings.justification: This evidence directly states that R&D expense (a component of operating expenses) increased in 2025 and that the increase was primarily due to AI-related costs. The period matches exactly (year ended December 31, 2025 vs 2024), and the filing explicitly attributes the primary cause to AI.

findings.key_quote: SG&A expenses increased $684 million, or 13%, in the year ended December 31, 2025 as compared to the year ended December 31, 2024 driven by a $354 million increase in operating expenses including legal charges
findings.justification: This shows that SG&A (another component of operating expenses) also increased in 2025, but the primary drivers were legal charges, employee costs, and stock-based compensation - not AI-related R&D. This is relevant context but does not decide whether AI was the primary driver of the overall operating expense increase.
